result.summary: Found 2 issues: duplicate restaurant listing and a placeholder-style icon used for two different food items.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Green Bowl Poke' listed twice in a row with identical image, delivery time, and price, which appears to be a data duplication error rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Verify backend data source and ensure unique restaurant entries are returned; remove or replace the duplicate card with a different restaurant.

issues.description: Both 'Green Bowl Poke' cards use the exact same generic plate icon/illustration instead of an actual photo of the dish, making them visually indistinguishable and looking like a placeholder graphic.
issues.suggestion: Replace with real food photography for each restaurant to improve visual distinction and appeal.
